Definition: had gone (3rd sg pluperfect subjunctive, shortened from īvisset)
may go / let him go (3rd sg present subjunctive)
in the speaking / by report (gerund, ablative)
from/to the same (dat/abl pl, shortened from eīsdem)
to/for him/her/it/that (dat) OR they (masc nom pl)
mouths / faces (nom/acc pl) — not ōra, ōrae 'shore'
and which / and the things which (quae + -que)
and with which; and the more (quō + -que) -- the long ō is the tell: the adverb quoque 'also' has a short o
to be about to be (fut infin)
strength (nom/acc pl — the plural takes a different stem, vīr-)
